name: syoyo/tinygltf
description: Header-only C++11 library for loading and saving glTF 2.0 files, designed for easy integration with minimal dependencies. Used widely in game engines and research projects.
score_rationale: Extremely popular header-only glTF loader with 2.4k stars, MIT licensed, and the default choice for C++ projects needing lightweight glTF import.
summary: Lightweight header-only glTF 2.0 loader for minimal-dependency C++ projects
